landing_pads.path: full: release new+0x48, table slot := middle 0x64cf200, release new+0x38, base destructor on subobject, sized-delete new (0x58), then resume path
delete-only: sized-delete new (0x58), then resume path
resume: release destination+0x28, +0x18, +0x08 through helper when non-null, then _Unwind_Resume

new_object_layout.+0x48: copy of destination pair B second word, increfed (second incref of that target)
new_object_layout.+0x50: first slot of the lazy singleton record (address first+0x10)

refcount_event_order: incref destination+0x08 (pair A second word) when non-null
incref destination+0x18 (pair B second word) when non-null
incref subobject+0x28 (pair A second word, subobject's own reference) when non-null
incref new+0x48 (pair B second word, new object's own reference) when non-null
release previous destination+0x28 through helper 0x5d350c0 when non-null (tail jump); return otherwise
refcount_guard: guard byte at 0x64ed290: nonzero means plain increment, zero means locked increment (same rule as helper 0x5d350c0)

routine.kind: rebuild-and-replace: rebuild destination pairs, install fresh 0x58-byte object, release previous owner

singleton.record_b: 0x30 bytes: +0x00 = record_a+0x10, +0x08 = record_a, +0x18/+0x20/+0x28 = 0, +0x10 not written on init path

subobject_layout.init: 0x5fe7210: table slot overwritten to middle table 0x64cf200; +0x20/+0x28 = destination pair A copy, second word increfed
subobject_layout.init_tail: call 0x6099ce0(subobject, empty stack string, subobject+0x20, global 0x65051e0); heap result sized-freed (capacity + 1); callee effect not pinned
subobject_layout.teardown_link: base destructor 0x5fe70b0; derived table 0x64d08a8 and middle table 0x64cf200 match the RE-001 derived-destructor packet
